_shooting_todo: OQ-SHOOT-MODE (M2 H1a): the touch shooting mode. Every value below is a placeholder, not a design value: the default mode (advanced vs simple is Shibi's call), the hold-to-ADS switch (off by default) and its hold time, and the Simple first-shot delay. The player profile key shooting_mode (Settings, 'Shooting mode') overrides default_mode; an unknown or missing value means default_mode. See docs/CONTROLS.md Shooting mode.

shooting._modes_note: advanced: the right Fire button fires from the hip at once and its drag aims; Aim is a separate toggle. simple: no right Fire button (its area is look area); while the sight is up (Aim) and the crosshair is on a live enemy in the held gun's range and in clear sight, the touch HUD presses fire after simple.first_shot_delay_s. The optional Left Fire button is unchanged in both modes. Touch only: keyboard, mouse and gamepad fire as before.

hold_to_ads.note: Advanced only: a Fire button (right or Left Fire) held for hold_s raises the sight while it fires; release lowers it, unless the Aim toggle was on.

simple.note: time the crosshair must stay on the same target before Simple presses fire

_move_feel_todo: OQ-VJOY: move-stick feel. Every entry is a NEUTRAL placeholder (not a design value, not tuned). Applies to the VirtualJoystick move stick only; the custom stick keeps dead_zones.touch_move.

sprint._todo: OQ-SPRINT-NUMBERS: every value below is a placeholder, not a design value. The forward threshold is a fraction of the stick radius; higher sprint sensitivity = lower threshold (docs/CONTROLS.md Sprint).

layout_editor._todo: OQ-LAYOUT-EDITOR (G2e): every range below is a placeholder, not a design value and not PUBG's. size_pct is a percent of the element's default size; alpha_pct a percent of full opacity. An element's touch target never goes below min_target_dp, whatever the slider says.

check_sizes._note: Viewports checked for off-screen elements, landscape only (OQ-PORTRAIT): Fold cover, Fold inner, the two small test sizes and (M2 H1a) the two Ultra sizes of tests/test_front_end_sizes.gd.

layout_editor._layout_version_h1c_note: M2 H1c item 4 (OQ-CROUCH): 2 -> 3, the Crouch button moved the Cover / Shoulder slot, Swap and the fire-mode button defaults, so layouts saved at 2 are reset once to the new defaults (with the one-time notice).
layout_editor._layout_version_note: M2 H1a (OQ-H1A-LAYOUT): format version written with the saved layouts (profile hud_layouts.version). A stored layout with a lower or no version was made for an older default placement and is reset to the defaults once on load (SaveService), the legacy profile sprint_lock_pos with it. Raise it only when a new default placement makes old saved positions wrong.

shoulder_pulse_scale.note: OQ-SHOULDER: immediate Shoulder press scale; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value), Material / Ainur press-feedback band (Shibi's citation; no local reference); scale only, alongside the existing camera shoulder ease

shoulder_pulse_release_s.note: OQ-SHOULDER: return to ONE starts immediately on touch-down and restarts on a new press; Shibi-approved industry default 2026-10-28 (Shibi's pick, not a DESIGN.md value), Material / Ainur press-feedback band (Shibi's citation; no local reference). Release curve: ease-out quadratic, scale = 1.0 - (1.0 - shoulder_pulse_scale) * f * f, f = time left / shoulder_pulse_release_s; EL's pick 2026-10-28, not a Shibi number, not a Material spec claim, not a DESIGN.md value

touch_layout._contrast_note: P0 playtest contrast: ring_alpha was 0.35 and the button idle fill 0.22 (too faint on the Fold). Values here are placeholders pending playtest (OQ-35).
touch_layout._sticks_todo: OQ-35: rest centres of the sticks are placeholders: [x as fraction of width, y as fraction of height]. Move bottom-left. look_stick_rest is used only in look mode 'stick' (look.mode); in 'drag' (the default) no look stick is drawn (M2 H1a). Buttons no longer hang off it (button_anchor); M2 H1a moved it from [0.88, 0.78] (now the Fire / Reload corner) into the look area.
touch_layout._move_stick_note: Which move stick the touch HUD builds. 'virtual' (the default) = Godot 4.7 VirtualJoystick; 'custom' = the hand-written stick, kept as a working fallback. The player profile (Settings in the main menu) overrides this value. See docs/CONTROLS.md and OQ-VJOY.
touch_layout._move_stick_visible_note: M2 H1c (OQ-STICK-VISIBLE, Shibi Nov 17 2026: the stick takes up too much of the screen): false (the default) = the move stick works exactly as before (same touch area, rest point, dead zone, sprint gesture, rects) but nothing is drawn, no base and no knob, for both stick kinds (move_stick 'virtual' and 'custom'). true = today's drawing. The layout editor always shows it so it can be dragged. Placeholder pending playtest, not a design value.
touch_layout._vjoy_layout_note: Only used when move_stick is 'virtual'. 'floating' (default): JOYSTICK_DYNAMIC, a touch anywhere in the left half (move_zone) spawns the base under the thumb. 'fixed': JOYSTICK_FIXED at move_stick_rest, only touches on the stick grab it; other touches go to look.
touch_layout._vjoy_todo: OQ-VJOY: all values below are trial placeholders, not design values. Sizes are fractions of the custom stick radius / ring.
touch_layout._buttons_todo: OQ-35, OQ-H1A-LAYOUT (M2 H1a): button size, min_dp, font, ring ratio and offsets are placeholders, not design values. offset = [dx, dy] of the button centre from button_anchor (a screen point, [x of width, y of height]; the bottom-right corner), in primary button sides (button_size_frac_of_height of the HUD height, at least button_min_dp; negative = left/up), so the layout keeps its shape where the 48 dp floor makes buttons relatively big. ring = an outer-ring button, ring_size_ratio of a primary side, never below button_min_dp. Keys of buttons are InputMap actions. See docs/CONTROLS.md Touch layout.
touch_layout._anchors_note: M2 H1a (OQ-H1A-LAYOUT): screen points [x of width, y of height] the buttons hang off: button_anchor (the bottom-right corner, the default) and bottom_centre_anchor (buttons.<key>.anchor names it; data/ui.json interact_button.anchor too).

crouch._todo: OQ-CROUCH, OQ-H1A-LAYOUT (M2 H1c item 4, Shibi Nov 17 2026: 'there isn't even a Crouch button'): the free-crouch toggle (Pawn.handle_action_press('crouch') through TouchProvider.trigger_action, as Cover). touch_layout._layout_note: M2 H1a (OQ-H1A-LAYOUT): the primary buttons in thumb reach at the bottom-right corner (Fire at the right edge in the corner, Aim above it, Reload left of it on the bottom edge); the outer ring along the bottom edge: Jump left of Reload, (M2 H1c item 4) Crouch left of Jump, the Cover / Shoulder slot just left of the screen centre (was just right of it), Swap left of it (where the weapon slots sit in most mobile shooters); data/ui.json interact_button above the Cover / Shoulder slot, fire_mode_button on the bottom edge left of Swap (M2 H1c: off the move stick where they meet, see its note), pause_gear top-right. On 1512x648 at 420 dpi the right edge holds only Aim and Fire under the gear (56 dp down, clear of the top text), so the ring is on the bottom edge. look_area is the rest of the right half. Every rect on every test size: tools/layout_probe.gd.
touch_layout._look_area_note: M2 H1a (OQ-H1A-LAYOUT): the main look area, where the right thumb turns the view and no control sits by default. Each edge = a fraction of the HUD (left_frac etc.) moved in by inset_buttons primary button sides (the unit of the button offsets above, so it follows the 48 dp floor). Touches outside it in the right half still turn the view (look_zone); this is only the area kept clear of controls. The layout editor warns, never blocks, when a saved layout puts a control in it (layout_editor.overlap_policy). Placeholder, not a design value.
touch_layout._swap_shoulder_note: Path A phase 2 (Shibi GO via EL, Oct 27 2026): the Shoulder button flips the local camera between the right (default, camera.json shoulder_side) and left shoulder. View only, never sent to the host. The swap_shoulder InputMap action has no keyboard or gamepad binding yet (OQ-SHOULDER). M2 C1b: the same slot is the Cover button on the ground (data/ui.json cover_button). M2 H1a: the slot is an outer-ring button on the bottom edge (offset above, OQ-H1A-LAYOUT).
touch_layout._sprint_lock_note: G2L, M2 H1a (OQ-H1A-LAYOUT): the one default position of the movable Sprint lock button: above the move stick, up and to the right of its lock target. sprint_lock_offset = [dx, dy] of its centre from the lock target's rest centre (sprint.lock_target, above the move stick rest), in lock button sides at 100 % (sprint.lock_button, at least min_dp), so it keeps its place where the 48 dp floor makes buttons relatively big. (It was a screen fraction, sprint_lock_pos [0.56, 0.42], right of centre in the look area.) The profile value (sprint_lock_pos, fractions) overrides it; a saved value from before M2 H1a is reset once (SaveService). Its size and min_dp stay in sprint.lock_button.
touch_layout._left_fire_note: G3e: optional second Fire button for the left thumb, off by default. pos = [x of width, y of height] of its centre, on the left half above the move stick and clear of the Sprint lock target. Placeholder position, not a design value (OQ-LEFT-FIRE-POS). Not a key of buttons: those are InputMap actions; this one presses the existing fire action.

left_fire.note: optional second Fire button for the left thumb (G3e); size = button_size_frac_of_height, at least button_min_dp
